entries.0b118be42de1756a: It provides maintenance parts and services for equipment already delivered, along with equipment upgrades (modifications that add new functions), and also sells used equipment.
entries.2043f617223fab8f: A company that develops and manufactures equipment for making semiconductors and sells it to semiconductor makers around the world, and also maintains and modifies the equipment it has delivered.
entries.3fa9b22690add1b7: It sells new semiconductor manufacturing equipment, installs it at customers' factories, and adjusts it so that it can fully perform to specifications. In its earnings briefing materials, it shows revenue from new semiconductor manufacturing equipment broken down by application into 'DRAM', 'non-volatile memory' and 'non-memory (logic, [[term:foundry|foundry]], others)'.
entries.48faeb32bb8f9549: This is equipment used in testing (inspection) to determine whether the chips formed on a wafer are good.
entries.4a9fd0241fa9b37a: This equipment removes film on the wafer along the circuit pattern created by coating, exposure and developing.
entries.524b09bcf51292e3: A light-sensitive resin (photoresist) is evenly applied to a [[term:wafer|wafer]] (the round plate that forms the basis of a semiconductor chip); after the circuit pattern is transferred with an exposure tool, part of the resin is dissolved and removed with developer solution to form the circuit pattern.
entries.532c1b309b1192f4: It develops, manufactures and sells manufacturing equipment used in factories that make [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]], and also provides maintenance services for the equipment it delivers.
entries.6da339f79479cb62: This equipment forms extremely thin films on the wafer surface, such as insulating films (films that do not conduct electricity) and metal films, which become the materials for devices and wiring.
entries.6e1e37f45648dfbb: This is equipment that removes foreign matter and other contaminants from circuits between manufacturing steps to prevent defects from forming.
entries.7fb608cf27ab5096: It sells new semiconductor manufacturing equipment, installs it at customers' factories, and adjusts it so that it can fully perform to specifications.
entries.cde9c621dd2a9bee: It develops, manufactures and sells manufacturing equipment used in factories that make [[term:semiconductor|semiconductors]], and also provides maintenance services for the equipment it delivers. The business of Tokyo Electron Limited consists of only one [[term:segment|segment]] of this '[[term:semiconductor-manufacturing-equipment|semiconductor manufacturing equipment]]'.
entries.eb36e9fd9522dd39: A light-sensitive resin (photoresist) is evenly applied to a [[term:wafer|wafer]] (the round plate that forms the basis of a semiconductor chip); after the circuit pattern is transferred with an exposure tool, part of the resin is dissolved and removed with developer solution to form the circuit pattern. This is the coating and developing equipment that handles the 'coating' and 'developing' steps among these.
